easyPrerequisites:
You control at least four creatures.
You control a basic Swamp.
description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Cast Lab Rats with buyback by paying {B} due to its affinity for creatures, creating a creature token and returning Lab Rats to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping the basic Swamp.
Repeat.
